import inspect
from fastapi import routing
from fastapi_cli.config import FastAPIConfig
from fastapi_cli.discover import get_import_data, get_import_data_from_import_string
from uvicorn.importer import import_from_string
config = FastAPIConfig.resolve()
data = get_import_data_from_import_string(config.entrypoint, config.from_pyproject) if config.entrypoint else get_import_data()
app = import_from_string(data.import_string)
print('ALL', getattr(routing, '__all__', None))
print(inspect.getsource(routing.iter_route_contexts))
def line(prefix, ctx):
    convertors = {k: type(v).__name__ for k, v in (getattr(ctx, 'param_convertors', None) or {}).items()}
    endpoint = getattr(ctx, 'endpoint', None)
    print(prefix, type(ctx).__name__, type(ctx.route).__name__, type(ctx.original_route).__name__, repr(ctx.path), repr(ctx.path_format), sorted(ctx.methods or []) if ctx.methods is not None else None, getattr(endpoint, '__qualname__', type(endpoint).__name__), convertors)
def walk(routes, prefix=''):
    for ctx in routing.iter_route_contexts(routes):
        line(prefix, ctx)
        inner = getattr(ctx.route, 'routes', None)
        if type(ctx.route).__name__ in ('Mount', 'Host'):
            print(prefix + '   app', type(ctx.route.app).__module__ + '.' + type(ctx.route.app).__qualname__, 'routes of it:', None if inner is None else len(inner))
            if inner:
                walk(inner, prefix + '      ')
walk(app.routes)
